CourtListener.title: CourtListener
CourtListener.description: Free Law Project's legal research platform — millions of U.S. court opinions, PACER dockets, judge profiles, oral arguments, and citation verification.

DocketRouter.title: DocketRouter
DocketRouter.description: A verification layer over an open legal library: check that a reporter citation exists (18M citations, 'found' or 'unverified', never 'nonexistent'), check whether a cited opinion supports a proposition, and read statutes and court rules word for word. Use CourtListener to find cases and this to verify them and for the rules and statutes it does not carry.
